svg.title: EffiPed system architecture
svg.desc: A camera frame passes through the stem and first two stages of ConvNeXt V2 Tiny. A two-scale neck fuses the stride-4 and stride-8 features into a 256-channel map at stride 4. A detection head predicts a centre heatmap, box, offset and IoU quality, decoded with Soft-NMS. An identity head pools each detected box with RoIAlign, applies Coordinate Attention, splits four body strips, weights them with strip attention and normalises a 256-D descriptor. A per-camera tracker matches detections with motion, IoU and appearance; cross-camera search ranks other cameras' tracks by cosine similarity for human review.
